-- One GlobalString read. See this file's header: the table is the player's own, executed -- off their chain at boot, and absent in a bare-XML harness. local function gs(key, fallback) local value = getglobal(key) if value and value ~= "" then return value end return fallback or "" end

-- ── The window (ref-lua l.168-194) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- The reference's tab handling is commented out in its own OnLoad (ref-lua l.170-171) and -- OnShow (l.176) — 1.12 ships this window with no tab strip — so it is not transcribed. function HelpFrame_OnLoad(frame) frame:RegisterEvent("UPDATE_GM_STATUS") end
function HelpFrame_OnShow(frame) HelpFrame_ShowFrame("Home") if UpdateMicroButtons then UpdateMicroButtons() end PlaySound("igCharacterInfoOpen") GetGMStatus() end
-- ref-lua l.183-194. arg1 == 1 means the petition queue is up; anything else takes it down, -- and -1 additionally says so out loud. Against vmangos, SMSG_GMTICKETSYSTEMSTATUS only -- ever carries 0 or 1, so the -1 leg is faithful but unreachable here (header note). function HelpFrame_OnEvent() if event == "UPDATE_GM_STATUS" then if arg1 == 1 then PETITION_QUEUE_ACTIVE = 1 else PETITION_QUEUE_ACTIVE = nil if arg1 == -1 then StaticPopup_Show("HELP_TICKET_QUEUE_DISABLED") end end end end
-- ref-lua l.196-229. `key` is either a HELPFRAME_FRAMES key (a category id, "Home", -- "GMHome", "OpenTicket") or something unknown, which falls through to the ticket editor — -- the reference's own default, and what makes a category with no route still openable. function HelpFrame_ShowFrame(key, ticketType) if HelpFrame.openFrame then HelpFrame.openFrame:Hide() end
-- Asking for the editor with the queue down closes the window and says why. if key == "OpenTicket" and not PETITION_QUEUE_ACTIVE then HideUIPanel(HelpFrame) StaticPopup_Show("HELP_TICKET_QUEUE_DISABLED") return end
local frame local frameInfo = HELPFRAME_FRAMES[key] if frameInfo then local targetName = frameInfo.name if targetName == "HelpFrameGeneral" then HelpFrame_SetupGeneralFrame(key) end frame = getglobal(targetName) else frame = getglobal(HELPFRAME_FRAMES["OpenTicket"].name) end frame:Show() HelpFrame.openFrame = frame
if ticketType then HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketType = ticketType end end
-- ref-lua l.231-349. The shared general page re-dressed for one category: a title, body -- text, up to two bullet sections with their own headings, an optional trailing paragraph, -- and up to two action buttons — each element re-anchored to whatever ended up above it, -- which is why this is a chain of SetPoints rather than a static layout. function HelpFrame_SetupGeneralFrame(key) local info = GENERAL_HELPFRAME[key] if not info then return end if info.title then HelpFrameGeneralTitle:SetText(info.title) end if info.titleText then HelpFrameGeneralTitleText:SetText(info.titleText) end if info.bulletTitle1 then HelpFrameBulletTitle1:SetText(info.bulletTitle1) else HelpFrameBulletTitle1:SetText("") end
local bulletIndex = 1 local bullet if info.bullets1 then for index, value in ipairs(info.bullets1) do bullet = getglobal("HelpFrameGeneralBullet" .. bulletIndex) -- Unreachable: MAX_GENERAL_BULLETS is 10 and the longest run configured above -- is 7. The reference's `message(...)` dev assert is dropped (header, 8). if bullet then getglobal("HelpFrameGeneralBullet" .. bulletIndex .. "Text"):SetText(value) bullet:Show() if index > 1 then bullet:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "HelpFrameGeneralBullet" .. (bulletIndex - 1), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, HELPFRAME_BULLET_SPACING) end bulletIndex = bulletIndex + 1 end end end
if info.bulletTitle2 then HelpFrameBulletTitle2:Show() HelpFrameBulletTitle2:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "HelpFrameGeneralBullet" .. (bulletIndex - 1), "BOTTOMLEFT", -5, HELPFRAME_SECTION_SPACING) HelpFrameBulletTitle2:SetText(info.bulletTitle2) else HelpFrameBulletTitle2:Hide() end
if info.bullets2 then for index, value in ipairs(info.bullets2) do bullet = getglobal("HelpFrameGeneralBullet" .. bulletIndex) if bullet then getglobal("HelpFrameGeneralBullet" .. bulletIndex .. "Text"):SetText(value) bullet:Show() if index == 1 then bullet:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "HelpFrameBulletTitle2", "BOTTOMLEFT", 5, HELPFRAME_BULLET_SPACING) else bullet:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "HelpFrameGeneralBullet" .. (bulletIndex - 1), "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, HELPFRAME_BULLET_SPACING) end bulletIndex = bulletIndex + 1 end end end
for i = bulletIndex, MAX_GENERAL_BULLETS do getglobal("HelpFrameGeneralBullet" .. i):Hide() end -- Floor of 2, so a category with NO bullets still has "bullet 1" to anchor under -- (ref-lua l.293; the anchors below all read bulletIndex-1). bulletIndex = max(bulletIndex, 2)
if info.endText then HelpFrameEndText:SetText(info.endText) HelpFrameEndText:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "HelpFrameGeneralBullet" .. (bulletIndex - 1), "BOTTOMLEFT", -5, HELPFRAME_SECTION_SPACING) HelpFrameEndText:Show() else HelpFrameEndText:Hide() end
-- The action button. CATEGORY_TO_NOT_DISPLAY is nil here — its only setter is -- Localization.lua's enGB LocalizeFrames(), which benilla does not ship (header note). if info.buttonText and (not (CATEGORY_TO_NOT_DISPLAY and (CATEGORY_TO_NOT_DISPLAY == key))) then HelpFrameGeneralButton:SetText(info.buttonText) HelpFrameButton_FitToText(HelpFrameGeneralButton) if info.endText then HelpFrameGeneralButton:SetPoint("TOP", "HelpFrameEndText", "BOTTOM", 0, HELPFRAME_SECTION_SPACING) else HelpFrameGeneralButton:SetPoint("TOP", "HelpFrameGeneralBullet" .. (bulletIndex - 1), "BOTTOM", 0, HELPFRAME_SECTION_SPACING) end HelpFrameGeneralButton.onClick = info.buttonOnClickFunc HelpFrameGeneralButton:Show() else HelpFrameGeneralButton:Hide() end
-- titleText2 / button2 (ref-lua l.322-348). No configured entry sets titleText2, so the -- -300 x-offset below never runs today; kept because button2 (Stuck's "Page a GM") does. if info.titleText2 then HelpFrameGeneralTitleText2:SetText(info.titleText2) HelpFrameGeneralTitleText2:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "HelpFrameGeneralButton", "BOTTOM", -300, HELPFRAME_SECTION_SPACING) HelpFrameGeneralTitleText2:Show() else HelpFrameGeneralTitleText2:Hide() end
if info.button2Text then HelpFrameGeneralButton2:SetText(info.button2Text) HelpFrameButton_FitToText(HelpFrameGeneralButton2) if info.titleText2 then HelpFrameGeneralButton2:SetPoint("TOP", "HelpFrameGeneralTitleText2", "BOTTOM", 0, HELPFRAME_SECTION_SPACING) else HelpFrameGeneralButton2:SetPoint("TOP", "HelpFrameGeneralButton", "BOTTOM", 0, HELPFRAME_SECTION_SPACING) end HelpFrameGeneralButton2.onClick = info.button2OnClickFunc HelpFrameGeneralButton2:Show() else HelpFrameGeneralButton2:Hide() end end
-- ref-lua l.351-359. Opening the window dismisses both ticket dialogs — you are about to be -- shown the same choice in a bigger frame. function ToggleHelpFrame() if HelpFrame:IsVisible() then HideUIPanel(HelpFrame) else ShowUIPanel(HelpFrame) StaticPopup_Hide("HELP_TICKET_ABANDON_CONFIRM") StaticPopup_Hide("HELP_TICKET") end end
-- ── The ticket editor (ref-lua l.389-486) ────────────────────────────────────────────── -- UPDATE_TICKET's arguments, the reference's own block comment (ref-lua l.409-423): -- arg1 category · arg2 description · arg3 ticket age (days) · arg4 oldest ticket (days) -- arg5 how stale that oldest-ticket figure is (days; > 1 hour means bad data) -- arg6 assigned-to-GM flag (0 no, 1 a GM, 2 the escalation queue) -- arg7 opened-by-GM flag (0 never, 1 yes) function HelpFrameOpenTicket_OnEvent(eventName) -- The GM SURVEY branch, structurally faithful and deliberately inert (header, 1). The -- reference dresses the toast as a survey invitation, flashes it, and returns; we take -- the same early return so nothing below can misread a survey event as a ticket, but we -- neither paint nor flash it, because GMSurveyFrame_LoadUI (the thing the toast would -- then open) does not exist here. CHOSEN_FOR_GMSURVEY (GlobalStrings l.749) and -- UIFrameFlash go with it. if eventName == "GMSURVEY_DISPLAY" then return end
if arg1 and arg1 ~= 0 then -- There IS an open ticket. TicketStatusTitleText:SetText(gs("TICKET_STATUS1")) -- GlobalStrings l.4238 HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketType = arg1 HelpFrameOpenTicketText:SetText(arg2)
-- The reference's `ticketFrameHeight` (35 / 40 / 52) is DEAD WEIGHT and is -- dropped: it is assigned on three legs (ref-lua l.424, 444, 451) and read on -- none — the toast's height comes from the measured text at l.460, below. -- ReputationFrame.xml's precedent for dropping the reference's own unread locals. local statusText HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketTimer = nil if arg7 == 1 then -- A GM has already opened it: no estimate, just a state. if arg6 == 2 then statusText = gs("GM_TICKET_ESCALATED") -- l.2020 else statusText = gs("GM_TICKET_SERVICE_SOON") -- l.2022 end else -- Estimate = how much older the oldest open ticket is than yours, in seconds. local estimatedWaitTime = (arg4 - arg3) * 24 * 60 * 60 if estimatedWaitTime < 0 then estimatedWaitTime = 0 end
-- 0.042 days is ~1 hour: the reference's own "this data is stale, do not quote a -- number" threshold (its comment at ref-lua l.415). if arg4 < 0 or arg5 < 0 or arg5 > 0.042 then statusText = gs("GM_TICKET_UNAVAILABLE") -- l.2023 elseif estimatedWaitTime > 7200 then statusText = gs("GM_TICKET_HIGH_VOLUME") -- l.2021 elseif estimatedWaitTime > 300 then statusText = format(gs("GM_TICKET_WAIT_TIME", "%s"), SecondsToTime(estimatedWaitTime, 1)) -- l.2024 -- Only this leg arms the live countdown below. HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketTimer = estimatedWaitTime else statusText = gs("GM_TICKET_SERVICE_SOON") -- l.2022 end end if statusText then TicketStatusTime:Show() TicketStatusTime:SetText(statusText) TicketStatusFrame:SetHeight(TicketStatusTitleText:GetHeight() + TicketStatusTime:GetHeight() + 20) end
HelpFrameOpenTicket.hasTicket = 1 HelpFrameOpenTicketSubmit:SetText(gs("EDIT_TICKET")) -- l.965 HelpFrameOpenTicketCancel:SetText(gs("EXIT")) -- l.1933 HelpFrameOpenTicketLabel:SetText(gs("HELPFRAME_OPENTICKET_EDITTEXT")) -- l.2216 else -- No open ticket. On the wire the server answers a no-ticket -- CMSG_GMTICKET_GETTICKET with a status-only body and the app fires UPDATE_TICKET -- with a single arg1 = 0 — this leg is what puts the form back to SUBMIT/CANCEL, -- so it is load-bearing, not defensive. HelpFrameOpenTicketText:SetText("") HelpFrameOpenTicket.hasTicket = nil HelpFrameOpenTicketSubmit:SetText(gs("SUBMIT")) -- l.4211 HelpFrameOpenTicketCancel:SetText(gs("CANCEL")) -- l.465 HelpFrameOpenTicketLabel:SetText(gs("HELPFRAME_OPENTICKET_TEXT")) -- l.2217 end end
-- ref-lua l.478-486. Edit vs create is the only difference, and both close the window. function HelpFrameOpenTicketSubmit_OnClick() if HelpFrameOpenTicket.hasTicket then UpdateGMTicket(HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketType, HelpFrameOpenTicketText:GetText()) else NewGMTicket(HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketType, HelpFrameOpenTicketText:GetText()) end HideUIPanel(HelpFrame) end
-- ── The toast (ref-lua l.488-501) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- Entering the world asks for the ticket; every UPDATE_TICKET after that shows or hides the -- toast, and the temporary-enchant column steps down out of its way. The -175 restore is -- BuffFrame's own declared anchor, not the reference's -180 (header, 4). function TicketStatusFrame_OnEvent(frame) if event == "PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD" then GetGMTicket() elseif arg1 ~= 0 then frame:Show() if TemporaryEnchantFrame then TemporaryEnchantFrame:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", "UIParent", "TOPRIGHT", -205, -frame:GetHeight()) end refreshTime = GMTICKET_CHECK_INTERVAL else frame:Hide() if TemporaryEnchantFrame then TemporaryEnchantFrame:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", "UIParent", "TOPRIGHT", -175, -13) end end end
-- ref-lua l.544-561. Two independent timers on one tick: a 10-minute re-poll of the server, -- and the local countdown of the estimate it last gave us. Runs only while the toast is up. function TicketStatus_OnUpdate(elapsed) if HelpFrameOpenTicket.hasTicket then if refreshTime then refreshTime = refreshTime - elapsed if refreshTime <= 0 then refreshTime = GMTICKET_CHECK_INTERVAL GetGMTicket() end end if HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketTimer then HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketTimer = HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketTimer - elapsed TicketStatusTime:SetText(format(gs("GM_TICKET_WAIT_TIME", "%s"), SecondsToTime(HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketTimer, 1))) end end end
-- The toast's click. The reference writes this body TWICE — TicketStatusButton's OnClick -- (ref-xml l.1485-1496) and the frame's own OnMouseUp (ref-xml l.1513-1524) are character -- for character identical, because the 32px icon does not cover the whole 208px toast. -- One function, wired from both. function TicketStatus_OnClick() if TicketStatusFrame.hasGMSurvey then -- The survey branch (header, 1): the reference opens GMSurveyFrame and hides the -- toast. Deferred, and deliberately not stubbed into "hide the toast" — that would -- silently eat a survey the player agreed to take. return elseif StaticPopup_Visible("HELP_TICKET_ABANDON_CONFIRM") or StaticPopup_Visible("HELP_TICKET") then StaticPopup_Hide("HELP_TICKET_ABANDON_CONFIRM") StaticPopup_Hide("HELP_TICKET") elseif not HelpFrame:IsVisible() then StaticPopup_Show("HELP_TICKET") end end
-- ── The GM category list (ref-lua l.503-534) ─────────────────────────────────────────── function HelpFrameButton_OnClick(button) HelpFrame_ShowFrame(button.key, button.ticketType) end
function HelpFrameGM_Update() HelpFrameGM_UpdateCategories(GetGMTicketCategories()) end
-- The vararg is a FLAT id/name list, so row i reads the pair at 2*(offset+i)-1. Lua-5.0 -- `arg.n`/`arg[i]` written the 5.1 way (header, 6). function HelpFrameGM_UpdateCategories(...) local n = select("#", ...) local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(HelpFrameGMScrollFrame) for i = 1, NUM_GM_CATEGORIES_TO_DISPLAY do getglobal("HelpFrameButton" .. i):Hide() end for i = 1, NUM_GM_CATEGORIES_TO_DISPLAY do local index = 2 * (offset + i) - 1 local button = getglobal("HelpFrameButton" .. i) local text = getglobal("HelpFrameButton" .. i .. "Text") if index <= n then -- Both reads are pinned to ONE value: `select(i, ...)` returns the whole tail, -- and as the last argument of a call that tail would expand. local id = select(index, ...) local name = select(index + 1, ...) text:SetText(name) -- key AND ticketType are the same DBC id: one picks the page, the other rides -- the wire (this file's header). button.key = id button.ticketType = id button:Show() else button:Hide() end end -- n/2 categories, 37px a row. With the ten DBC rows against ten displayed this leaves -- the bar (and its trough) hidden, which is the reference's look too. FauxScrollFrame_Update(HelpFrameGMScrollFrame, n / 2, NUM_GM_CATEGORIES_TO_DISPLAY, 37) end
-- ref-lua l.536-542. A configured override (only Stuck has one) or the default route into -- the ticket editor. function HelpFrameGeneralButton_OnClick(button) if button.onClick then button.onClick() else HelpFrame_ShowFrame("OpenTicket") end end
